items.text: Among women referred to group pelvic floor classes between September 2025 and August 2026, which recorded factors and reported barriers are associated with completing four or more of six sessions?
items.population: Women referred to group pelvic floor muscle training, September 2025 to August 2026
items.intervention: Recorded factors (age, distance, interpreter need) and reported barriers (childcare, embarrassment, class timing) as exposures
items.comparator: Women without each factor or barrier
items.outcome: Completion of four or more of six sessions, from booking records
items.setting: Teaching hospital women's health physiotherapy service

finer: Feasible within the printing budget and administrative help; interesting to the service and to referrers; novel in linking barriers to recorded attendance; ethical once the board has decided; relevant to an imminent redesign.
summary: One PECO question on factors associated with completion.
